quote: Le Président de la République défini la politique générale en matière de Protection Civile.
note: Defines policy only; operational coordination is left to administrative authorities (M-CM-02). Source transcription (CamerLex) contains typos.

quote: L’emploi des moyens de la Protection Civile est laissé à l’appréciation des autorités administratives.
note: Broad discretion, no named alert authority.

quote: l’Observatoire National des Risques (ONR) est l’organe central en charge de la gestion de l’information sur les aléas et les menaces qui pèsent sur les populations. Il est créé mais non encore totalement opérationnel.
note: Contingency plan (2011), not binding law. The body in charge of hazard information was not fully operational: candidate G4. Alert dissemination itself is assigned by Decree 98/031 (M-CM-25).

quote: de la .participation du Ministère en charge des télécommunications à la coordination de la prestation des services d'alerte au public
note: The ministry only 'participates' in coordinating public alert services; no power to order operators found.

quote: de la définition du rôle des opérateurs des télécommunications dans les télécommunications d'urgence, en liaison avec les Administrations concernées
note: The operators' role in emergency telecoms is still to be defined by an administrative service: no duty in the decree itself. Supports G1.

quote: l’acheminement gratuit des communications électroniques d'urgence
note: Universal service covers free routing of emergency communications (calls to emergency services), not the broadcast of public warnings. Ambiguity feeds G1.

Searched CM-02, CM-03, CM-04, CM-05, CM-07, CM-08, CM-09, CM-10, CM-11: no duty for operators to relay public alerts. Decree 98/031 gives 'la diffusion de l'alerte' to the competent authority without naming any channel. Not yet checked: CM-20 (ART licence conditions, to obtain).

No text empowers an authority to order operators to broadcast a public alert. The national crisis committee (CM-07 art. 7) includes neither the telecom minister nor operators. Requisition of property under a state of emergency (M-CM-30) is the closest power. Not yet checked: CM-20.
No rule on validating AI outputs in the Cameroon corpus. Official SNIA text (CM-19) and data law (CM-01, scan) not yet checked.

quote: la prévention, par des précautions convenables, et l’intervention, par la distribution des secours nécessaires, en cas d'accident et de fléaux calamiteux, tels que les incendies, les inondations ou tous autres accidents naturels
note: Mayor's municipal police powers explicitly cover floods (Act 2: local leader).

quote: A state of emergency may be proclaimed throughout the national territory or in any part thereof in the event of
note: Law 90-47, Section 1, English column of the gazette: includes 'an occurence which, by its nature and gravity, is considered a national disaster'. Proclaimed by decree, max. three months (Section 2).

quote: est chargée de la régulation des activités de sécurité électronique, en collaboration avec l’Agence de Régulation des Télécommunications
note: ANTIC regulates electronic security with ART; no explicit power to block or correct a fake alert found. Supports G9.

quote: celui qui publie ou propage par voie de communications électroniques ou d’un système d’information, une nouvelle sans pouvoir en rapporter la preuve de véracité
note: Spreading unverifiable news is an offence; penalties doubled when aimed at public peace. Applies to the fake 'dam broken' SMS.

quote: ils sont tenus d’informer les usagers
note: Operators must inform users of security risks on their networks; not a duty to correct a false public alert.

quote: Le fournisseur de contenus est responsable des contenus véhiculés par son système d’information
note: Content-provider liability (dignity, honour, privacy); no text on liability for harm caused by a false or AI-generated public alert. Supports G6.

Weather service (DIRMET) only named as a data producer in the contingency plan (CM-10#sec-18). Decree 98/031 does not mention it either. No text found giving it a mandate to issue warnings. Supports G2.
Only rules found are publication of laws in French and English (e.g. CM-02#art-104). No duty on languages or coverage of public alerts. Supports G7.

quote: l’information du public
note: Decree 98/031 art. 3(3): informing the public is part of the competent authority's action (prefect, governor or Secretary General of the Presidency). No rule on content, timing or channel.

quote: Il est chargé de la mise en oeuvre de la politique générale de la protection civile, en temps normal comme en période de crise
note: National Civil Protection Council (Decree 96/054), as summarised by a Civil Protection report (secondary source, OCR). Confirm on the decree itself (CM-06, to obtain).

quote: celui qui procède ou fait procéder à un transfert de données à caractère personnel faisant l'objet ou destinées à faire l'objet d'un traitement vers un état étranger ou une organisation internationale, en méconnaissance des dispositions de la présente loi
note: Law 2024/017: transfer abroad requires prior authorisation of the data protection authority (art. 32, damaged by OCR; art. 60 fine). No emergency fast-track found: supports G10. Extension (Act 3).

quote: Sans autorisation préalable de l'Autorité de protection des données à caractère personnel
note: Fine of 10 to 50 million CFA francs for a controller or processor transferring data to a third country without prior authorisation.

quote: Le traitement des données à caractère personnel relatif notamment à la sécurité, à la défense, à la santé, à la justice et à l’état civil est régi par des textes spécifiques, en tant que de besoin
note: Health data processing is left to specific texts 'as needed': none found in the corpus. Supports G5.

quote: à l'exécution d’une mission d'intérêt public
note: Exception to prior consent for processing necessary to a public-interest mission (possible basis for crisis use).

quote: la diffusion de l’alerte
note: Decree 98/031 art. 3(3): the authority that triggers the emergency plan (prefect at department level, governor at province level, Secretary General of the Presidency at national level) disseminates the alert. No channel, deadline or operator duty is specified: supports G1, nuances G2.

quote: Le déclenchement du plan d’urgence en cas de catastrophe ou de risque majeur se fait
note: Three levels: prefect (department), governor (province), Secretary General of the Presidency (national).

quote: Le plan d’urgence ne peut être déclenché que lorsque l’autorité compétente est en possession des renseignements sûrs, ne donnant lieu à aucun doute
note: The plan (and thus the alert) may only be triggered on certain information. A probabilistic AI forecast ('70%') cannot meet this test, and no procedure says who checks it: supports G3 and G8, and may delay alerts (Act 2).

quote: de coordonner les actions de secours publics
note: Crisis committees meet automatically at department, province and national level (art. 4).

quote: le ministre chargé de la communication
note: The national crisis committee includes the communication minister but neither the telecom minister nor operators; the chair may call on any competent person (art. 7(2)). Supports G1/G2.

quote: autorize the requisition of persons and property in accordance with the law
note: Only once a state of emergency is proclaimed (Law 90-47, Section 6(4)). Not specific to telecom networks or alerts.

quote: organize the control of the press and of all kinds of publications, audio-visual broadcasting
note: Only under a state of emergency (Section 6(2)). Control, not a duty to inform or correct.

quote: de sanctionner les manquements des opérateurs à leurs obligations
note: ART can sanction operators' breaches, but no public-alert obligation was found for it to enforce (see M-CM-07). Supports G1.

quote: d’exercer toute autre mission d’intérêt général que pourrait lui confier le Gouvernement
note: A public-alert mission could be entrusted to ART by the Government; no such act found. Supports G1.

quote: the competent authorities may, either sua sponte or at the request of the Prosecutor-General, issue any of the writs stipulated in this Decree-Law if they have verified the dissemination, re-dissemination, or circulation of illegal content or content containing false data
note: Writs to correct, interrupt, disable and block access. Unofficial English translation; check Arabic text and 2024 amendment (AE-13).

quote: Whoever uses the information network or any ITE to announce, disseminate, re-disseminate, circulate, or recirculate false news or data
note: Penalty: at least one year and AED 100,000; covers content 'contrary to what has been announced officially' and content that spreads terror.

quote: Whoever creates a fake website, an account or an email and attributes it falsely to any natural or legal person
note: Impersonation of an issuer (fake alert sender).

quote: emphasizes the irreplaceable value of human judgment and human oversight over AI
note: Charter principle 6, non-binding. No binding rule on validating AI outputs before a public alert found. Supports G3.

quote: emphasizing the importance of governance and accountability in AI
note: Charter principle 7, non-binding; does not allocate liability. Supports G6.

Searched AE-05 (telecom law, 2003 as amended), AE-12, AE-06: no statutory duty for operators to relay public warnings, nor deadline or cost rule. Operator obligations reportedly sit in TDRA technical specification TS040 (AE-10, secondary summary only). NCEMA founding law (AE-07) not publicly accessible to the team. Candidate G1 (duty in technical regulation, not in law); medium confidence.

quote: Issue general directives and instructions on matters relating to the telecommunications sector in the interest of national security or international relations
note: Closest basis for ordering operators to broadcast: general directives on national-security grounds. Not specific to public warnings; procedure and delay not stated.
NCM mandate text not found (AE-11) and NCM report not found (AE-15). Report as 'text not accessible', not as a legal gap.

NCEMA founding law (AE-07), Civil Defence law (AE-08) and NCEMA 7000 (AE-14) not found by manual search on 2026-11-07. NCEMA's coordination role is known only from secondary sources (CTX-01). Not a legal gap.

quote: Terms and standards of services provided to subscribers by Licensees
note: TDRA alone sets service terms for licensees: the likely legal basis of the UAE-Alert technical specification (AE-10). Generic, does not mention warnings.

quote: Not to publish, broadcast, or circulate false news, forged papers, or those incorrectly attributed to entities or persons.
note: Media content standard (Media law 55/2023). Prohibits false or misattributed news; no duty to correct a false public alert found in AE-12. Supports G9 (prohibition without correction procedure).

quote: Governmental entities which control or process Personal Data
note: The PDPL does not apply to government entities or government data (art. 2(2)): crisis processing by NCEMA or police falls outside it, and no specific framework was found. Supports G5.

quote: If the processing is necessary to protect public health, including protection from existing diseases and epidemics
note: Exception to consent for private controllers (art. 4(5)).

quote: Personal Data may be transferred to outside the State in the following cases
note: Transfers to countries without adequate protection allowed in listed cases (contract, consent, etc.); no emergency fast-track found. Extension (Act 3).

quote: Messages should support both English and Arabic languages.
note: From a secondary summary (Kiwa, 2015) of the TDRA technical specification TS040, not the law nor the official text. No rule found on other languages spoken in the UAE or on geographic coverage. Supports G7 (partial).
